## First: everyone in a project {.section-divider}

[10 minutes, live]{.eyebrow}

::: {.notes}
⏱️ 10 min, live demo. Do NOT skip this — Session 3 goes straight to ggplot2
and assumes a data frame is on screen. Walk the room; red stickies up.
:::

## Four panes

| Pane | Use it for |
|---|---|
| **Source** (top left) | Your script. What you keep. |
| **Console** (bottom left) | Scratch. Nothing saved. |
| **Environment** (top right) | What exists right now |
| **Files / Plots / Help** | Browsing, figures, `?fn` |

<kbd>Ctrl/Cmd + Enter</kbd> — Source → Console. That is the loop.

## A project that survives you

```
meded-conclave-2026/
├── meded-conclave-2026.Rproj
├── data/      # READ-ONLY. Never edit.
├── R/         # 01_clean.R, 02_analyse.R
├── output/    # everything regenerable
└── README.md
```

::: {.notes}
Three rules: raw data read-only; number the scripts; output/ must be
deletable without loss.
:::

## The workflow

```
Import → Tidy → [ Transform ⇄ Visualise ⇄ Model ] → Communicate
```

. . .

Import and tidy take **60–80%** of the time.

No methods section has ever said so.

## Three words that are not synonyms

| | Question | Example |
|---|---|---|
| **Statistics** | Bigger than chance? | Does the flipped arm score higher? |
| **Machine learning** | Predict new cases? | Who will fail the OSCE? |
| **Generative AI** | Produce plausible text? | Draft this figure's code |

::: {.notes}
⏱️ 8 min. The distinction that matters: fluency ≠ truth. Foreshadow Day 2
afternoon, don't teach it here.
:::

## Thumb rules

::: {.incremental}
1. Restart R often
2. Look at the data — `glimpse()`, before and after
3. Small steps, checked
4. Read the error's first line
5. Name things for humans
6. Did it twice? Script it
:::

## Check your setup — 5 min {background-color="#0f5257"}

```r
getwd()
list.files("data")
library(tidyverse)
students <- read_csv("data/meded_students.csv")
glimpse(students)
```

240 rows, 17 columns. Red sticky if not.
